Graduate Program Admission
Transform Communities as a Leader and Global Citizen With a Graduate Degree from Saint
Louis University
Saint Louis University's graduate programs lead to a range of academic degrees, including
Master of Arts, Master of Science, Master of Business Administration, Juris Doctor,
Doctor of Medicine and Doctor of Philosophy. In addition, many academic departments
at SLU offer graduate certificate programs and accelerated or dual-degree options.
In all, SLU offers more than 80 post-baccalaureate and professional degree programs, with many earning national recognition in U.S. News & World Report’s annual “Best Graduate Schools” edition.
Focused on advanced degrees in health care, STEM, business, law, the humanities, education
and more, 13 colleges, schools and centers at SLU offer master's and Ph.D. programs,
both online and on the ground at our St. Louis, Missouri, and Madrid, Spain campuses.

Graduate Admission Requirements
Admission requirements for SLU graduate programs vary. Visit the program’s page to learn about specific admission criteria. In general, most graduate programs at
SLU require applicants to:
Complete an Online Application
SLU's application portal does not require an application fee. If you are using a centralized application
service like SOPHAS, ATCAS, CSDCAS, HAMPCAS, etc., you will be required to pay the
application fee charged by these centralized services.
Apply for Graduate Admission
Submit Official Copies of All College Transcripts
Transcripts and Credentials During COVID-19
Due to the spread of COVID-19, we will only be accepting electronic application credentials,
including official transcripts. We strongly encourage applicants to reach out to their
previously attended institutions to determine if they are equipped to send official
transcripts to us through an e-delivery service. If the institution has e-delivery
capabilities, please follow their process for sending official transcripts to Saint
Louis University Graduate Admission. We can also accept transcripts emailed directly
to graduate@slu.edu from a prior institution's registrar office as official.
Out of care and concern for our students, we will accept unofficial transcripts to
allow for your application to be reviewed for admission. Please send unofficial transcripts
as an attachment to graduate@slu.edu. Please include your name and program applied to in the subject line of the email.
Official transcripts will be required to finalize your admission, prior to the end
of your first semester of enrollment.
Meet Any Department-Specific Requirements
Each department has different requirement standards. Prospective students should contact each school for specific information regarding test score requirements.
International Students: Meet English Language Requirements
In addition, international students are required to:
Meet English language requirements by earning minimum TOEFL or IELTS scores.

Paying for Graduate School
Saint Louis University offers multiple scholarship, fellowship and assistantship opportunities for graduate students.
Fellowships are awarded to newly accepted master's or doctoral-level students who demonstrate
outstanding scholastic achievement and potential for success.
Assistantships are awarded by individual programs and not through the Office of Graduate Admission.
Please contact the department to which you are applying for more information.
Additionally, SLU graduate students can seek financial support beyond assistantships
and fellowships. To qualify for federal student loans, you must be enrolled in a minimum
of three credit hours, meet the eligibility criteria and file your Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) for the current year. (SLU’s FAFSA code is 002506.)
